title: Feature theme map and prioritized asks (Oct 2025)
content:
Purpose: quick synthesis from the past 6 weeks of inbound feedback (support tickets, CSM conversations, ecosystem partner calls). Goal: produce a consumable set of feature asks, rough impact notes, and candidate next steps for product/eng prioritization.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Three cross-cutting themes emerged repeatedly: routing/resilience (fallbacks + multi-model policies), predictable cost controls (per-route budgeting + cheaper quantized variants), and observability for quality regressions (eval-linked alerts + example-level tracing).
- Customers range from small AI-native startups asking for low-effort cost controls to regulated enterprises demanding private deployment runbooks and audit-ready behavior.
- Priority requests below include suggested owners and a quick RICE-style note (R: reach, I: impact, C: confidence, E: effort) given our current understanding. R/I/C/E are qualitative here.

Methods and sources:
- Reviewed 93 support threads (July–Sept 2025), 12 enterprise QBR notes, and notes from 8 solution-engineering calls.
- Pulled trending Jira tags: CS_FEATURE_ASK, HOSTED_COST, PRIVATE_ONBOARD.
- Relied on product analytics for most-called APIs and error types (top errors: 429s during bursts, fallback latency spik es).

Theme A — Smart routing & graceful degradation
Observations:
- Customers want predictable uptime during peak; several reported hard failures when preferred model or region is saturated. Many ask for an "automated fallback" to a cheaper/lower-latency model.
- Enterprise legal teams ask for explicit policy records (which model+region was used per request) for audits.
- Small teams want a simple toggle: "allow fallback: on/off" at a project or route level.

Representative quotes:
- "When the p99 spikes we lose product trust — we need an auto-fallback, not 503s." — fintech-customer
- "We need a record that shows which model served each request for audits. Not optional." — healthcare-platform

Suggested asks and notes:
1) Offer a per-route fallback policy builder in Console (UI + API). Owner: product-hosted-api. Priority: high. R/I/C/E: high/high/medium/medium.
2) Add model-routing audit logs (append model-id + region to request logs / export). Owner: infra + observability. Priority: high for enterprise. R/I/C/E: medium/high/high/low.
3) Provide a documented set of compatible model variants for fallback (e.g., quantized vs full). Owner: applied-ml + model-onboarding. Priority: medium. R/I/C/E: medium/medium/medium/medium.

Theme B — Cost predictability & controls
Observations:
- Requests cluster around per-route budgets, token caps with alerts, and cheaper approximate variants (quantized, short-context models) selectable by rule.
- Folks building PLG funnels want a way to detect high-cost paths and gate them (e.g., require approval for >X tokens).

Representative quotes: 
- "We had a runaway job that ate credits — need per-route spend limits and notification hooks." — growth-startup
- "Suggesting quantized model recommendations for our prompt patterns would be huge." — mid-market SaaS

Suggested asks and notes:
1) Per-route spend budgets with webhook alerts and soft-block option. Owner: product-hosted-api + billing. Priority: high. R/I/C/E: high/high/medium/medium.
2) 'Cost suggestion' analysis in Optimize: For a given route, recommend a cheaper model/quant profile and estimate delta. Owner: optimize team. Priority: medium-high. R/I/C/E: medium/high/low/high.
3) Allow token pre-allocations for scheduled jobs (reserve capacity + cheaper rate). Owner: dedicated + billing. Priority: medium. R/I/C/E: low/medium/low/high.

Theme C — Observability for quality regressions
Observations:
- Multiple customers flagged silent regressions after model rollouts. They asked for example-level diffs, automatic evals against golden prompt sets, and regression alerting.
- Need: tie model version and prompt to a failing example trace. Also want signal-to-noise improvements — don't spam with low-value alerts.

Representative quotes:
- "We rolled a minor model update and overnight our summaries got worse. Why wasn't this flagged?" — enterprise search vendor

Suggested asks and notes:
1) Integrate evals into rollouts: automatic sample-set eval runs + fail-if-drop thresholds. Owner: product-console + release-engineering. Priority: high. R/I/C/E: high/high/medium/high.
2) Example-level trace linking in Console: show the prompt, model version, token counts, and embeddings diff for flagged examples. Owner: observability. Priority: high. R/I/C/E: medium/high/low/medium.
3) Configurable alert thresholds and alert deduping (group by route+issue). Owner: observability + product. Priority: medium. R/I/C/E: low/medium/high/low.

Theme D — Private & compliance onboarding friction
Observations:
- Regulated customers expect an onboarding playbook for Private installs (network policies, KMS integration, audit checklist). Many ask for a pre-flight checklist and an estimated timeline.
- They also ask for compliance artifacts: SOC2-friendly guidance, encryption attestations, and sample SOPs.

Representative quotes:
- "We need a clear runbook for Private deploys — our security team won't accept hand-wavy timelines." — healthcare enterprise

Suggested asks and notes:
1) Publish a Private deployment onboarding playbook + target timelines and resource checklist. Owner: private-deployments + solutions-engineering. Priority: high. R/I/C/E: medium/high/high/low.
2) Provide packaged compliance artifacts (SOP templates, KMS integration examples). Owner: security-and-compliance + legal. Priority: medium. R/I/C/E: medium/medium/high/low.

Lower-frequency items (watchlist)
- Better default prompt templates for autocomplete/chat embeddings use cases (product-ux).
- More granular SDK timeouts and retry knobs surfaced in UI.
- First-class support for reranking with embeddings pipeline examples.

Quick wins we can consider this quarter
- Add a simple "allow_fallback" toggle to route configs (backend + Console checkbox). Low engineering effort; high customer love. Owner: product-hosted-api.
- Onboarding doc: Private deployment checklist (doc-only) + sample timeline. Owner: solutions-engineering. Low effort.
- Billing: add basic per-route spend alert via webhook (limit alerts only; soft-block in next quarter). Owner: billing.

Open questions / unresolved items (notes to self)
- What SLA language do we need to attach to fallback policies? Do we expose SLOs per-model variant?
- For audit logs: retention requirements vary by customer — what's our default and can we make it configurable per-tenant?
- How to balance alerting sensitivity for regression detection to avoid too many false positives?
- Need concrete sample prompts and failure examples from 3 enterprise customers to prototype the eval gating flow.

Action items / next steps
- Share this doc with product-hosted-api and observability for feedback by Oct 17. (Owner: Aisha)
- Kick off 2-week spike to implement route fallback toggle prototype (eng spike, measure burst behavior). Proposed participants: serving-runtime, product. (Owner: Marcus Chen)
- Create a short Private onboarding checklist + ship as public doc by Oct 24. (Owner: Becky Huang)

Appendix — sample ticket excerpts (choppy, verbatim)
- "CS-#1489: 503s during 8/26 release window, customer wants fallback to smaller model. Impact: product blocked."
- "QBR note: customer X requests model-level auditability for PHI workloads. Waiting on legal input."
- "Slack: @solutions we need a one-pager for private install time estimates — security asking timeline."

File notes: informal synthesis, rough RICE, ask owners to annotate with feasibility and rough engineering estimates. This is a working doc — please add inline notes rather than creating forks.
